rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when stopping a person from doing an action.

example.english: We prevent the kids from running around in the street.
example.traditional: 我哋唔畀細路喺馬路度亂跑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 bei2 sai3 lou6 hai2 maa5 lou6 dou6 lyun6 paau2

rows.note: This is the broad lexical choice for actively stopping an event, plan, or person.

example.english: The security guards acted to prevent a fight.
example.traditional: 保安即刻阻止咗場打鬥。
example.jyutping: bou2 on1 zik1 hak1 zo2 zi2 zo2 coeng4 daa2 dau3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for preventing an unwanted result, such as tooth decay or an accident.

example.english: Brushing your teeth every day can prevent tooth decay.
example.traditional: 每日刷牙可以防止蛀牙。
example.jyutping: mui5 jat6 caat3 ngaa4 ho2 ji5 fong4 zi2 zyu3 ngaa4

rows.note: Use this when prevention is planned in advance, especially for illness, injury, or danger.

example.english: Getting a flu shot can prevent the flu.
example.traditional: 打流感針可以預防流感。
example.jyutping: daa2 lau4 gam2 zam1 ho2 ji5 jyu6 fong4 lau4 gam2
